newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off 0.05 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off 0.05 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.05 percent to close at 1.0491 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market after the Central Bank set a weaker mini-band for the currency of 1.0490 to 1.0540 per dollar, dealers said.
The previous mini-band was set on Feb 13 between 1.0485 and 1.0535 reais to the dollar.
Late in the day, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0490 real per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Tuesday surplus of $63 million.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real fell 0.06 percent to close at 1.0549 to the dollar, following the lowering in the mini-band.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed steady at 1.082 per greenback.
